svg.title: From inbox to reviewed knowledge.
svg.desc: Extract sources, using one worker per image when needed. The main agent drafts full text and a summary against the sources. Review the sources and proposed filing, and validate structure, links and TeX. Revise the draft when needed; after review, file the document, keep the original, and update the catalog and related-document links.
